水浸し refers to something being completely soaked or submerged in water. It can describe anything from a wet floor to a flooded area, and the tone can vary from mild inconvenience to serious damage, depending on context.

A room or object is covered in water due to leaks, floods, spills, etc.


Clothes or paper are drenched


Figuratively, when something is overwhelmed by a flood of emotions or things (less common)

部屋が水浸しになる – the room gets flooded


靴まで水浸しだ – even my shoes are soaked


書類が水浸し – the documents are soaked with water

台所の蛇口が壊れて、床が水浸しになった。
